source_base: Prepared v4.9.0 full site source (logo and heading release), revised to read live CAMPAIGN and PAID DATE headers on Google Sheet. Last checked live site v4.8.8 already returned eight C002 assignments.

key_stats.data_scope: cohort: matching WEEK N source tab; clicks: matching WEEK N cohort within selected calendar week
key_stats.leaderboard: Top 5 published articles only, by clicks recorded during selected week
key_stats.full_placements_location: Historical > Week N, starts collapsed unless opened from Key Stats

historical.source: Google Sheets WEEK N - OWNER tabs, dynamically discovered when headers are ready
historical.campaign_badges: named campaign when assigned; otherwise tracking prefix A01 etc
historical.weekly_clicks: Recorded dated events for selected source week, not lifetime per-code clicks
historical.x_metrics: Most recent observation available on/before historical week end; display unavailable when missing
historical.paid_cards: All paid Historical placements use the existing pink source gradient; unpaid published posts remain white.
historical.excludes: Unpaid and unposted Planned drafts. Groups composed exclusively of drafts are hidden.
historical.included: All published posts plus paid Scheduled placements, including later-inactive posts; week summaries reflect included placements.
historical.weekly_kpi_colours: Live articles uses the same vivid pink gradient as Dashboard. Paid total uses the same blue-to-navy gradient. Both use the same faded sparkle tile and white text.

backend_modified: netlify/lib/sheet-source.mjs: optional CAMPAIGN precedence and PAID DATE date mapping

deploy.next_action: In existing Netlify project only, run npm ci && npm test, verify full 8 Functions and live Sheet read, preview pages, publish safely. Never visit live /r redirects during diagnostics.

visual_484.blue_card: same money gradient on both Key Stats blue cards
visual_484.sparkle_tile: 178x146px; 4 faded dots per tile, opacity 0.25 consistent across all coloured cards
visual_484.initial_loading: spinner for initial KPI and weekly chart fetch; unavailable values retain dash after failed/complete fetch

visual_485.coloured_kpis: unchanged blue/charcoal; live pink gradient shares same variable

visual_486.coloured_sparkles: existing shared faded tile, 0.25 opacity; also on paid history cards
visual_486.week_summary: five figures before the visible published and paid-scheduled placements in each open Historical source week
visual_486.excluded_click_controls: link hidden; direct page and existing cookie logic preserved
visual_486.account_comparison: public CTA hidden, route inaccessible, compatibility internals retained
visual_486.back_controls: small padded buttons with SVG arrows

campaigns_487.qualifies: At least one paid and genuinely published X article
campaigns_487.grouping: Explicit Sheet campaign name/ID when assigned, else real attribution prefix A01/A02, never invented
campaigns_487.display: One blue-to-navy, sparkled details accordion per qualifying group, collapsed by default
expanded: Click-ranked published/paid placements and their detail controls
campaigns_487.hidden: Inactive campaigns without qualifying paid published articles, empty campaigns and new-campaign button

historical_487.keeps: Default-collapsed weekly cohorts with five period-specific KPIs, excluding unpaid unpublished drafts
historical_487.display: White accordions; pink Live articles and blue Paid total summary cards with consistent faded sparkles; paid article cards pink, unpaid published cards white

copy_487.missing_metrics: N/A, with existing initial loading spinners preserved

copy_488.date_labels: Week ranges use plain `to`, account sorting says Account A to Z

historical_488.colours: Matching Dashboard pink and blue on first two Historical summary cards; remaining three neutral with category accent
historical_488.sparkles: Same shared background tile, tile size and 0.25 opacity as all coloured cards

typography_489.headings: Primary and visible section/chart headings and KPI labels end with full stops. Black on white surfaces, existing accessible contrasts on coloured cards.

wordmark_490.font: Unbounded (OFL) Google Fonts with system fallback

backend_parser.reads: CAMPAIGN and PAID DATE columns by header on any compatible weekly tab
backend_parser.campaign_precedence: weekly column, else legacy PROMO META, else UNASSIGNED
backend_parser.payment_date_precedence: weekly PAID DATE, else legacy PROMO META, else blank
backend_parser.estimated_spend: fallback when payment dates unavailable; not presented as verified monthly spend
